summary: S2 Kyoto Disturbance (our eps 25-47) adapts Acts 58-106 (first HALF of the Kyoto arc, vols 8-13) — the context's 'chs ~47-151' overshoots: S2 stops at Act 106 and an announced S3 will finish the arc (107-151). The kenshin fandom episode pages carry exact per-episode chapter fields with page splits, fully consistent with the Act pages' reverse 2023ep mapping, with AFG's table (verbatim lineage-share with fandom, incl. the same ep-44 blank), and independently with Wikipedia: nearly every episode is titled after one of its acts and the volume boundaries match our stored ones exactly. Two episodes adapt no chapters: ep 34 (anime-original vignette built from Watsuki's own 2021-exhibition storyboard; fandom files it under Filler, MANTANWEB calls it the season's 'first completely new episode'; only a 2-page Act 81 pre-ending sliver) and ep 44 (Great Kyoto Fire Part Two — wholly anime-original battle expansion; no Act page maps to it). Eps 41-45 carry heavy anime-original padding around thin chapter loads (Act 98 split across two episodes; the fire trilogy expands Acts 100-102). Existing anchors eps 1-24 and the manual ep47→106 are all consistent with the new data; ep 47 confirmed as Acts 105-106 with AFG's continue-from-107.

Fandom categorizes it 'Filler Episodes' / 'first anime-original episode of the 2023 series'; MANTANWEB reports it is built from Watsuki's own storyboard exhibited at the 2021 25th-anniversary exhibition — author-created, hence anime-only-canon over plain filler (Sean flag below)

Great Kyoto Fire (Part Two): no manga chapters adapted — fandom's chapter field is blank, no Act page (100-102) maps to it, AFG's chapter cell is likewise empty; entirely anime-original battle expansion inside the canon fire night (Aoshi-vs-Kenshin on the Rengoku, Juppongatana vs police)

structure.notes: S2 'Kyoto Disturbance' (AniList 171637) = our eps 25-47, 23 episodes, adapts Acts 58-106 (vols 8-13) — only the FIRST half of the Kyoto arc; announced S3 will cover the rest (~107-151), so the context's 'chs ~47-151' scope belongs to S2+S3 together. Our cumulative numbering matches en.wikipedia and fandom 1:1 (no OVAs/specials in the count). Existing manual ep47→106 v13 anchor confirmed (fandom 105-106; AFG 'continue from Chapter 107'). Volume boundaries in the context file match Wikipedia's chapter list exactly for v8-v13. Fandom episode chapter fields and Act-page reverse mappings agree everywhere; AFG's table is a verbatim lineage-share of fandom (identical values including the ep-44 blank cell) so it was counted as corroboration, not independence — independence comes from Wikipedia title/volume matching (nearly every episode is titled after one of its acts) and MANTANWEB. DB episode rows 25-27 carry stale 1996-series titles/air-dates (flag #817 namesake collision); correct 2023 titles are To Kyoto / On the East Sea Road / The Abandoned Village (Oct 2024).
